title: Rethinking the Evaluating Framework for Natural Language Understanding in AI Systems: Language Acquisition as a Core for Future Metrics
reasoning: The paper's proposed metric documentation includes 'morality-related goals' as a key feature, and the secondary objective of the test is to qualify the 'wellbeing' benefit for all involved parties (agent, other agents, participants, and environment). This indicates that ethical and moral considerations are a core component of the proposed evaluation framework.
